sign: SOOT VAULTS. Wages paid below. Questions are not.
Someone has scratched under it: 'Nobody who collects comes back up.'
pike_intro: Pike: Payday's downstairs, sunshine. Your name's not on the list.
pike_defeat: Pike: Fine. Go on. Tell 'em Pike says he's sick.
pike: Pike: Fine. Go on. Tell 'em Pike says he's sick.
smudge_intro: Smudge: I write down who goes in. I've never had to write who comes out.
smudge_defeat: Smudge: I'll put you down as 'probably'.
smudge: Smudge: I'll put you down as 'probably'.
nettle_intro: Nettle: Every coin down here has a name on it. Usually a dead one's.
nettle_defeat: Nettle: Your account is closed. Congratulations, I suppose.
nettle: Nettle: Your account is closed. Congratulations, I suppose.
brask_intro: Brask: You owe. Everyone owes. Babies owe for the noise.
brask_defeat: Brask: Put it on my tab. No, wait, that's the problem.
brask: Brask: Put it on my tab. No, wait, that's the problem.
coll_intro: Coll: Drains go where the clan don't look. Neither should you.
coll_defeat: Coll: Alright, alright. Mind the grey water. It bites.
coll: Coll: Alright, alright. Mind the grey water. It bites.
wynn_intro: Wynn: I keep the kilns hot so the books stay dry. Sweet little job.
wynn_defeat: Wynn: If anyone asks, the fire went out on its own.
wynn: Wynn: If anyone asks, the fire went out on its own.
ottery_intro: Ottery: Every cage has a price tag. Yours just went up.
ottery_defeat: Ottery: Keys are on the hook. I never saw you. I never see anyone.
ottery: Ottery: Keys are on the hook. I never saw you. I never see anyone.
lume_intro: Lume: The Paymaster pays me to be a wall. I'm a very good wall.
lume_defeat: Lume: Walls crack. Nobody tells you that in wall school.
lume: Lume: Walls crack. Nobody tells you that in wall school.
dilly_intro: Dilly: I sweep up after the Paymaster. You would not believe what people leave behind.
dilly_defeat: Dilly: Including their dignity, apparently. Mine.
dilly: Dilly: Including their dignity, apparently. Mine.
mabry_intro: Mabry: I forge signatures for a living. Want to see mine? It's yours.
mabry_defeat: Mabry: Good fight. I'll sign for it. In your name.
mabry: Mabry: Good fight. I'll sign for it. In your name.
teo_intro: Teo: I dive the ash pits for lost coins. Found a whole uncle once.
teo_defeat: Teo: He was fine. Grumpy, but fine.
teo: Teo: He was fine. Grumpy, but fine.
quill_intro: Quill: Everything down here is pawned. The cages, the guards, the Paymaster's smile.
quill_defeat: Quill: Here's a ticket for your pride. Redeem it never.
quill: Quill: Here's a ticket for your pride. Redeem it never.
crake_intro: Crake: Wages are fear, paid weekly. You came to collect? Everyone does, once.
Crake: Your rival sold me your route an hour ago. She drives a hard bargain. You don't.
crake_defeat: Crake: The books don't balance. They never did. I just kept a heavier pen.
Crake: Take the cage keys. The clan will want a new Paymaster by morning. They always do.
crake: Crake: I'm counting the days until they replace me. It's a short count.

lines: Fitch: First time in the Vaults? Pay my toll, a hundred and fifty, and the guards look the other way.
Fitch: Trust me. Everyone down here does. Eventually.

fitch_no: Fitch: Suit yourself. The Vaults remember stingy faces.
fitch_betray: Fitch: Pleasure doing business. Now the second part of the toll: these lads.
Fitch: Nothing personal. Tibb's family vouches for people. Yours didn't.
fitch_kept: Fitch: Tibb says you brought his Mirkmole back. Family's family. Here, and the guards are yours to argue with.
fitch_ambush_defeat: Fitch: Alright! Alright. Keep the coins. Keep my dignity too, I'm not using it.
ledger_fitch: Paid a guide in the Soot Vaults to keep the guards off. He brought the guards himself.
juno_3_intro: Juno: Last plate's mine, rookie. I didn't come all this way to come second.

lines: Juno: Fine. You win the plates. I already won the Paymaster's money for your route.
Juno: Don't look at me like that. In Ashmere, a rival is just a friend who invoices.

juno_3: Juno: See you in the next act. Bring coins. I'll bring a buyer.
ledger_juno: Raced Juno Sallow for the wage plates. She lost the race and sold my route to the Paymaster anyway.
auditor_intro: Vey: I'm the new Paymaster. They hired me this morning, before the old one even lost.
Vey: Ashmere plans ahead. Mostly funerals.
auditor_defeat: Vey: Noted. Filed. Forgotten by Thursday. That's the system, sweetheart.
auditor: Vey: Noted. Filed. Forgotten by Thursday. That's the system, sweetheart.
scribe_intro: Orla: I copy the debts at night so nobody sees them grow.
scribe_defeat: Orla: Your name's in here twice now. Once as a debt, once as a warning.
scribe: Orla: Your name's in here twice now. Once as a debt, once as a warning.
tallyman_intro: Burke: I count. One, two, you're in trouble.
tallyman_defeat: Burke: Three. I always lose count at three.
tallyman: Burke: Three. I always lose count at three.
archive_shelf: Shelves of ledgers. Half of Ashmere owes the other half, and the clan owns both halves.

lines: A brass roller wrapped in a pawn ticket: 'Gorse, one press roller, cash.'

part_plain: Old printing parts in a pawn crate. Someone sold these cheap.

lines: A Mirkmole is asleep in a wage chest, snoring on a pile of coins that aren't yours.
It climbs into your bag like it's done this before.

mole_plain: An empty wage chest. Something has been sleeping in it.

lines: Three Shalebats in a cage, tagged 'Rook. Sold.' They know Bram's whistle.
You pop the lock. They follow you like a bad debt.
